title: Pitch Drips Once a Decade and Nobody Has Ever Seen It

scenes.text: One experiment has dripped for decades and nobody has seen a drop fall.
In 1930, a scientist cut the bottom of a funnel filled with pitch.
Pitch looks solid, but it's actually a liquid, billions of times thicker than water.
A drop forms slowly, and one falls about once a decade.
Nine drops have fallen so far.
And not one person has ever seen one fall.

description:
One experiment has dripped for decades and nobody has seen a drop fall.
The University of Queensland pitch drop experiment started in 1930. Nine drops have fallen and no human has ever watched one land.
Would you wait a decade to watch one?
thumbnail_text: NOBODY HAS EVER SEEN IT FALL
first_comment: Would you stare at a funnel for ten years to see it? Be honest.
